new_pr119.head: 4f42cbc57d146a765e5867434cab3680b4898209
new_pr119.body:
## Scope and exact source
Repair only verified failures from [Core PR #99](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/circula/pull/99), whose exact-head [run 44513300863](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/circula/actions/runs/44513300863) finished with four successful and five failed jobs.

Parent `0a73ee42b96255601cf2227b1ddf6599ec07a0ef`. Proposed repair `4f42cbc57d146a765e5867434cab3680b4898209`, tree `fff822903a19d418e70c75594c0a8b85b0a86042`. The one-commit change touches **exactly four test/harness files**; no Core production code, migrations, actions, vulnerability exclusions or feature manifests change.

- **Linux, macOS and Windows:** `TestFailingMigrationRollsBackAndReopensCleanly` assumed latest schema migration created >=2 objects; current migration 0021 has one. Preserve the original mid-DDL rollback assertion against the known two-trigger migration 0015, then still upgrade the same DB through the current head and verify the full migration record and original data.
- **Linux, macOS and Windows:** `TestHelpDocumentsSupportBoundaries` parsed a template without the production `msg` function, failing before it could assert the original support-boundary text. Register a test-only identity message formatter without changing any support text or removing assertions.
- **Linux:** `TestSQLiteWALWriteFailureRollsBackAndRecovers` saw zero WAL bytes in the parent after a genuine injected `SQLITE_IOERR_WRITE`. Keep a separate read transaction open to prevent last-connection WAL cleanup during writer discard, so the original exact partial-frame requirement, atomic rollback and recovery checks remain intact. This hypothesis must pass on the provider; no success is inferred.
- **Playwright:** 587/588 scenarios passed, but the session browser remained on the confirm page after an invalid-CSRF request via the shared cookie jar. Reload the form after the negative request to use the current CSRF token, then execute the same negative missing-confirmation and positive keyboard confirmation assertions. The browser rerun must establish whether token rotation was the cause.

**Outstanding blocker, intentionally not bypassed:** Gitleaks reported ten `generic-api-key` findings on SHA-256 file checksums and Git commit IDs in audit evidence JSON, not on product runtime code. Each match still requires verification and a representation fix that preserves exact evidence and full scanning. This PR does not suppress scanner rules or declare secret qualification passed.

All native, race, full SQLite driver, API/load, Playwright, security/lint, fuzz, packaged builds and reproducibility gates must pass on the ultimately published Core head. This PR is a pending test repair, not a CI pass or merge approval. Review independently before integration; preserve unrelated branches and disabled/HOLD future modules. No deployment or release.
